Look up taxonomy for accessions from NCBI

Source: R/taxonomy.R
taxonomy_from_ncbi.Rd

Looks up the lineage of each accession with the NCBI E-utilities web service (no local database needed). Only the accessions you ask for are downloaded, in batches. Requires an internet connection and the suggested packages rentrez and xml2.

Usage

taxonomy_from_ncbi(
  ids,
  api_key = Sys.getenv("ENTREZ_KEY"),
  cache = NULL,
  batch_size = 200,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

ids

Character vector of nucleotide accessions.

api_key

Optional NCBI API key. Defaults to the `ENTREZ_KEY` environment variable if set.

cache

Optional path to an `.rds` file used to store and reuse lookups between runs.

batch_size

Number of IDs per web request. Default 200.

verbose

Print progress messages. Default `TRUE`.

Value

A lineage table (see [read_taxonomy()]) with one row per ID that could be resolved.

Details

NCBI limits anonymous users to 3 requests per second; with a free API key (see <https://account.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/>) the limit is 10 per second. Use `cache` to store results in a file so that repeated runs do not download the same information again.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("rentrez", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("xml2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  try(taxonomy_from_ncbi(c("MW545606.1", "MZ509176.1")))
}
#>   looking up 2 accession(s) at NCBI
#>     2 / 2
#>           id   taxid    domain       phylum         class     order     family
#> 1 MW545606.1  463586 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae
#> 2 MZ509176.1 2909194 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida   Fabales   Fabaceae
#>      genus           species
#> 1   Ajania  Ajania potaninii
#> 2 Pueraria Pueraria sp. KK8s
# }
